description: Social Security earnings test (2025-2027) — How much of your Social Security benefit is withheld if you work before full retirement age, using SSA's 2025/2026/2027 limits ($25,560 and $67,920 in 2027). Works out your full retirement age and month from birth_date= (Jan-1 rule included), counts only pre-FRA earnings in the FRA year, full checks withheld, excess refunded next year, earnings level where all benefits stop, and grace-year non-service months. Params: earnings= (wages + net self-employment), birth_date=YYYY-MM-DD (or fra_status=under|fra_year|over), year=, monthly_benefit=, earnings_before_fra=, monthly_earnings= (12 comma values for the grace year). Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: finance_ss_earnings_test
